results.creator_credit: Jeff Spencer and Victoria. Ministry of Education
results.brief_description: Kerry Aulsbrook, an Education Officer specializing in natural history at the Museum of Victoria introduces Australian customs regulations prohibiting imports of animals and natural products. results.title: Dressing up in the past
results.creator_credit: Jeff Spencer, David Ferris and Victoria. Dept. of Education and Early Childhood Development
results.brief_description: Presents Lorri Baines, National Gallery Education Officer, demonstrating what the gallery offers children in terms of the history of clothing and costume.
